title: Truchas 2D flow boundary conditions
description: A collection of named flow boundary-condition definitions. Boundary names are user-defined and their input order is preserved by the simulation.

face-set-ids.description: One or more mesh face-set identifiers to which the boundary condition applies.

inflow-material.description: Material name assigned to material entering through this boundary. This option is available for velocity and pressure boundaries.

velocity.title: Prescribed velocity
velocity.description: A Dirichlet velocity boundary condition. The vector-function value may be a numeric array or an inline vector-function object.
Velocity vector as a direct numeric array or inline vector-function definition.

no-slip.title: No-slip boundary
no-slip.description: A no-slip wall boundary condition that sets the velocity to zero. The normal velocity is also zero.

free-slip.title: Free-slip boundary
free-slip.description: A free-slip wall boundary condition that sets the normal velocity to zero without prescribing tangential velocity.

pressure.title: Prescribed pressure
pressure.description: A Dirichlet pressure boundary condition. The pressure value may be a real number or an inline scalar-function object.
Pressure as a real number or inline scalar-function definition.
